Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have noted your cost model and historical data. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We are prepared to accept your proposed volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term. In consideration of these terms, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. Our offer contains a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken.

One more point from our side:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed your delivery and forecast data; while accurate, they do not impact our calculation.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can offer a revised price of EUR 31.30 per unit for the requested volume of 23,400 units and a 36-month contract. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. The validity of this Angebot is 7 days.

Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

decisions.tactician: o2 bundles the terms this supplier values but the cash model does not count: a 36-month binding commitment and a 56 d lead time. It can therefore accept less than its_level suggests. Step_10 at €30.18 gives our lowest C among the code rungs (€1.46M) while staying close to today's €29.89. E0 at €29.95 is slightly lower but is not an offered rung. Higher rungs give away too much on the first move. The shorter-lead options (o3-o6) cost far more, and o7's 12-month term carries a much higher C. I cite should-cost and order history to anchor the price. I leave out the 79.5% delivery record so as not to provoke them, and I leave out the forecast rise because it signals need on a capacity-constrained part.

decisions.tactician: o2 keeps the terms it already accepted, and its long commitment is something the supplier values beyond cash, so a lower price is plausible. step_10 at €30.75 is close to E0 (€30.64) and is more likely to be accepted because it stays within the €30.75 it reaches in about two replies at its current pace. Two new argument kinds (the weak delivery record and our rising forecast) add pressure without leaking urgency. Lead-time options o3-o6 cost far more, and accepting €31.70 now would leave value on the table while the supplier is still open.

why.tactician: The supplier is at final_offer and its price is still well above the health range, so it has no margin pressure that would push it to concede. Countering at o2's step_10 would save only about €23.6k (1,489,985 vs 1,513,541). That gain is small next to the walk-away risk, and a walk-away scores zero because we have no alternative and the part is single-sourced. We also have no unheard arguments to justify another push. The other options with shorter lead times or contracts cost more, and o7 is far worse. E0's default is not needed. Accepting offer:70410-2 now locks in the best standing sheet.
